CITY OF SAN MARINO

  PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA

Sharon Mequet, Chair
Joyce Gatsoulis­Batnij, Vice Chair  www.sanmarinoca.gov
Kevin Cheng, Commissioner  (626) 300­0700 Phone
Rick Chou, Commissioner  San Marino City Hall
Mark Giles, Commissioner  2200 Huntington Drive
  San Marino, CA 91108

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 26, 2026 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Planning
Commission with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 4th Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City at Planning@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626) 300­0700 4 8
hours prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom. The City will do
it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to participate in the meeting from home:
Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:
Public comment will be accepted by email to Planning@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00 p.m. the
day of the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. the day of the meeting
will be distributed to the Planning Commission during the meeting. Any comments received
after the 3:00 pm. deadline will be included in the public comment record but not provided to
the Planning Commission at the meeting.

Written public comment will be accepted electronically via zoom.us teleconference module

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION please contact the Planning Division at (626) 300­0700. A
copy of the staff reports under review at this Planning Commission meeting will be available
for public review by the end of the day, August 20, 2026 on the City’s website at:
www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Alternate Jeff Boozell, Alternate Brett Leitner, Commissioner Kevin Cheng, Commissioner Rick
Chou, Commissioner Mark Giles, Vice Chair Joyce Gatsoulis­Batnij, and Chair Sharon Mequet
POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.sanmarinoca.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Planning Commission
by submitting a public comment request and giving it to the Community Development Director
prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Planning Commission on items
that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Planning Commission may not discuss
or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.3).
The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to
follow up on such items.

1.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT
  NO. CUP 25­07 FOR A BATHROOM IN AN ACCESSORY STRUCTURE
  IN THE REAR YARD OF THE RESIDENCE AT 1045 SAN MARINO
  AVENUE (XU)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Planning Commission: (1) Determine that based on the whole of
  the administrative record, the proposed project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 3 (New Construction or Conversion of
  Small Structures), and that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an
  exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2
  applies; and (2) Adopt Resolution PCR 26­09 approving Conditional Use Permit Case
  No. CUP 25­07, subject to certain findings and conditions.
  Planner: Aubrey Stark­Miller, Assistant Planner

2.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NOS.
  DR 24­95 AND DR 26­04 AT 1458 HAMPTON ROAD THE
  CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW SECOND­STORY ABOVE AN EXISTING
  ONE­STORY RESIDENCE AND FAÇADE CHANGES (DAHL
  ARCHITECTS)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends the Planning Commission: (1) Determine that the proposed project is
  exempt from CEQA pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, § 15301, Class 1 (Existing
  Facilities), and that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to
  the categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines § 15300.2 applies; (2) Find
  that the project meets all applicable findings; and (3) Approve the project as
  proposed with the added conditions on PCR 26­10.
  Planner: Arielle Truong, Assistant Planner

  CONSENT CALENDAR

3.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve the
  minutes of the regular meeting of July 22, 2026.
